issues.claim: Exclusion consistency: CrossFit Stealth 2 and Spec On the Job
issues.problem: Borderline against the mapper's own exclusion rule. CrossFit Stealth 2 is a branded affiliate of a franchised system, and Spec On the Job is a multi-branch staffing operator, similar in shape to the multi-site PT chains the mapper excluded. Neither is a corporate chain in the Planet Fitness sense, so I do not count them as clear violations, but the rule is applied unevenly.
issues.fix: Decide one rule for branded affiliates/multi-branch operators and apply it to both entries.

Both sit in the same grey zone as the exclusions already made.
issues.fix: Check whether AZZ has a real South Plainfield site before outreach; decide whether multi-office groups are in or out.

issues.claim: Sourcing: entries resting only on a Bing Maps query URL
issues.problem: Roughly 30 entries cite an interactive Bing Maps query URL, which is not a page that documents the specific business, so those entries cannot be re-checked from the citation. Spot checks of two of them (Ramirez Insurance Agency, Master Key Realtors) were independently confirmed, which suggests the map data was transcribed faithfully.
